rubrics_metrics.name: Small Claims Court Exception
rubrics_metrics.description: Notwithstanding the agreement to arbitrate, either party may seek relief in a small claims court for disputes or claims within the scope of that court's jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arbitration Fee Coverage and Limits
rubrics_metrics.description: If AAA filing fees exceed the cost of filing a lawsuit, the Company will pay the additional cost. If the arbitrator finds the arbitration non-frivolous, the Company will pay all actual filing and arbitrator fees provided your claim does not exceed $75,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A request for payment of fees should be submitted to AAA with the initiating form; arbitration rules may permit recovery of attorney’s fees in certain circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Venue and Governing Law
